text: An initialization request to activate peering is received by the mediator.

source_sentence: 1. An initialization request to activate peering is received by the mediator.

text: The mediator instance obtains resource and access information from the SR and policy information from PR to establish negotiation.

obtains policy information from PR
establishes negotiation
source_sentence: 2. The mediator  instance  obtains  resource  and access  information  from the SR and policy information from PR to establish negotiation.

text: The mediator generates service requirements.
actions: generates service requirements
source_sentence: 3. The mediator generates service requirements.

text: If the service requirements are acceptable according to the provider’s policy, mediator passes it to the local PA.
actions: passes service requirements to the local PA
conditions: the service requirements are acceptable according to the provider’s policy
source_sentence: 4.  If  the  service  requirements  are  acceptable  according  to  the  provider’s  policy, mediator passes it to the local PA.

text: Else, reject user requests.
actions: rejects user requests
source_sentence: 5. Else, reject user requests.

text: If the user requests can not be accepted according the provider policies, service requirements are not passed to the local PA.

text: Local PA receives service requirements from the mediator.
actions: receives service requirements from the mediator
source_sentence: 1. Local PA receives service requirements from the mediator.

text: If any peering policies exist, they are returned to establish long-term peering arrangement.
actions: returns peering policies to establish long-term peering arrangement
source_sentence: 2.  If  any  peering  policies  exist,  they  are  returned  to  establish  long-term  peering arrangement.

text: Else, short-term negotiation is performed.
actions: performs short-term negotiation
source_sentence: 3. Else, short-term negotiation is performed.

text: Local PA in conjunction with the mediator interacts with external PAs through inter-PA communication protocol.
actions: interacts with external PAs through inter-PA communication protocol

text: External resources are discovered and negotiation is performed with selected CDN peers.

performs negotiation with selected CDN peers

exchange load information
identify an optimal peer to handle user requests

perform billing based on negotiated relationships
source_sentence: 4.  PAs  exchange  accounting  information  to  perform  billing  based  on  negotiated relationships.

assists in the administration of the functional policies
assists in the enforcement of the functional policies
source_sentence: 5. The policy repository instance in the established peering arrangement assists in the deployment, administration and enforcement of the functional policies.

causes a peering arrangement to cease
